classification_vocabulary.canonical: owns semantic or operational identity for its domain; other packages must reference rather than redefine it
classification_vocabulary.consumer: imports another package's contracts or capabilities without redefining their identity
classification_vocabulary.facade: compatibility, transport, or composition surface that does not own authority; may be inert or lazy
classification_vocabulary.projection: lossless or bootstrap view of another authority (markdown board, world view, inventory constant)
classification_vocabulary.legacy: historical path, spelling, or bootstrap source retained only for compatibility or migration
classification_vocabulary.duplicate: parallel record or import path that risks redefining identity already owned elsewhere
classification_vocabulary.experimental: landed but optional, pilot, or not product-gated for LGSWF continuous operation
classification_vocabulary.obsolete: retired flat path, superseded package assumption, or absent surface that must not be assumed present
classification_vocabulary.unresolved: required surface missing, upward violation, bootstrap failure, or candidate-only later tree content needing explicit disposition
